title: Audit the code against the settled rules and file cleanup issues
body: Once Design and Conventions are written, re-check each divergence from the 2026-09-28 survey against the final text. File one cleanup issue per divergence, or per file where one sweep fixes several, and note here anything accepted as is. The survey reports are in the notes.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/415c993d
notes.text:
Splits found in the 2026-09-28 survey: two conventions coexisting. Counts are grep-based. The first side of each is the one Claude would pick; none is decided.

Naming
1. profile vs prf for &Profile params: 11 vs 6. profile: in forward.rs:10, backward.rs:8, posterior.rs:5, traceback.rs:6, optimal_accuracy.rs:7, scoring.rs:223, trace.rs:213. prf: in cloud_search.rs:65,129,221,284.
2. target vs seq for &Sequence params: 8 vs 7. The changelog moved Seed fields to seq/prf.
3. profile_idx vs prf_idx vs p_idx: 19 / 2 / 4.
4. target_idx vs seq_idx: 7 vs 16.
5. _length vs _len: 170 vs 148. Pub fields use the full word (Profile.length, Sequence.length, target_length, profile_length); seq_len/prf_len appear as fields twice each.
6. forward_* vs fwd_*: full word for forward_time, forward_cells, forward_score, forward_matrix and the module names; fwd_tau, fwd_lambda and fwd_mx/fwd_cld/bwd_* locals.
7. p_value vs pvalue: 21 vs 3 (seed_pvalue_threshold, forward_pvalue_threshold).
8. _utf8 suffix vs digital_ prefix: consensus_seq_bytes_utf8, map_posterior_probability_to_bin_byte_utf8 vs Sequence.digital_bytes (sequence.rs:40).
9. Extension trait naming: *Ext in nail, *Utils/*Math/*Abuse in libnail.
10. valid() vs is_valid(): row_bounds.rs:95, cloud.rs:475 vs cloud.rs:155.

Errors
11. bail! vs return Err(anyhow!()): about 40 vs 1 (database.rs:500).
12. .context() on Option vs .ok_or(anyhow!()): many vs 1 (libnail util.rs:370).
13. thiserror vs hand-written impl Error: 4 vs 1 (IndexCollisionError, database.rs:70-85).
14. panic!() bare vs with message: about 12 vs 14 in libnail. Bare ones cluster in profile.rs:1212-1263 and alphabet.rs:131-168.
15. expect("") with an empty message: sequence.rs:73.
16. libnail returns anyhow from a library crate; typed errors only in sequence.rs.

Types
17. derive_builder (nail, 3) vs hand-written builders (libnail, 2).
18. bools vs enums for CLI flags: 7 bools in args.rs (only_seed, full_dp, no_null_two, use_accession, allow_overwrite, ali_to_stdout, print_summary_stats) beside SeedMode.
19. usize state consts (trace.rs:48-59, M_STATE = 1 ...) vs CoreState/BackgroundState enums (dp_matrix.rs).
20. Derived vs hand-written Debug: 8 core types hand-write it.
21. Single-impl traits: AlignStage (DefaultAlignStage only), IndexInner (IndexMap<String, Offset> only, database.rs:255).
22. Typed Index keys vs bare usize: ad_start_idx and block_offsets inside the matrices use usize.

Tests
23. test_ prefix vs bare names: about 25 vs 10 (database.rs tests: one_present, two_ambiguous_tail, five_absent ...).
24. assert2::assert (dp_matrix.rs:1133, cloud.rs:1511) vs std assert!.
25. Tolerances: 1e-3 (sequence.rs:249), 1e-5 (profile.rs:1105), 1e-9 (scoring.rs:444), no shared constant.
26. mod tests (10) vs mod test (scoring.rs:373) vs pub mod tests (fasta.rs:115); seeds.rs:92 has an empty mod tests {}.
27. Test return type: anyhow::Result<()> (most) vs () (test_advance_forward, test_cloud_relationship, test_dp_matrix_flat).

Docs and comments
28. Doc first letter capitalized (most) vs lowercase (few, e.g. "a helper function for writing tests involving Clouds" in cloud.rs).
29. Doc trailing period: 8% vs none.
30. Ad hoc markers inside fn bodies: "**NOTE:" at profile.rs:1051, "/// From HMMER:" at profile.rs:1064.
31. Re-exports in libnail/src/align/mod.rs:13-27: 5 named vs 3 glob; structs/mod.rs exposes Profile by two paths; output/mod.rs re-exports nothing.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/415c993d
notes.text:
Work items from the 2026-09-28 survey. Not conventions; each would be forbidden by a rule the Design section is likely to state. Candidates for their own cleanup issues once the rules are settled.

1. 24 println! in libnail non-test code, not feature-gated: util.rs:47-91 (print helper traits), needleman_wunsch.rs:20,58, dp_matrix.rs:117-133,950-956 (dump methods), cloud.rs:942-960 (ASCII cloud render).
2. Commented-out println! at cloud.rs:536-538 (from commit 837ba60) and sequence.rs:270 (test). Commented-out assertion block at profile.rs:1378-1381. About 4 more lines in dp_matrix.rs, 1 in cloud_stage.rs.
3. 4 todo!() in libnail: alphabet.rs:166-167 (DNA/RNA arms), trace.rs:137, profile.rs:1373 (test).
4. unwrap/expect in parsers and IO where Result is available: mmseqs.rs:438,493 file_name().unwrap().to_str().unwrap(); p7hmm.rs:61 expect("missing name in p7HMM"); pipeline/mod.rs:134 expect("no prf"); profile.rs:896 expect("NaN encountered"). Top files by unwrap+expect: mmseqs.rs 5, profile.rs 5, p7hmm.rs 4.
5. 5 stats-builder .build().unwrap() sites: align_stage.rs:137,217; cloud_stage.rs:143,173,206.
6. color-backtrace is a normal dependency in nail but dev-only in libnail; strum and strum_macros both declared.
7. libnail/src/structs/mod.rs exposes Profile as both structs::profile::Profile and structs::Profile.
8. 19 TODOs, 5 in dp_matrix.rs (180, 288, 439, 614, 722), others at traceback.rs:30,48, backward.rs:87, profile.rs:634.
9. DatabaseIter yields Option<Result<..>> (database.rs:229), the one place the two styles mix.
10. `unreachable!` bare at seed_stage.rs:213 vs with message at cloud_stage.rs:154.
